race.title: Horse And Jockey 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: NERIA is a well-bred filly who sets the standard on her French form and, open to improvement for her new top connections, looks the one to beat. Kenough has made the frame in both hurdle starts and, with the potential for better still firmly intact, is feared most. Maxminelli jumped none too fluently on his hurdles debut but is in excellent hands and is entitled to build on that initial experience. NERIA (FR) KENOUGH (FR) MAXMINELLI (IRE)
